name: Mikura Sawe
source:
Sawe is a sister and a principal at Seio Girls' Academy. She admitted [url=/c10778]Mizuho[/url] to the school, which makes her one of the few people who knew that Mizuho is a boy from the beginning.

Voiced by: Hitomi Aoi
